correctness.rationale: For each edge i let x_i count its goods allocated to i+1; self-value L_i=x_(i−1)+q−x_i. All-good EFX, crucially including deleting a good of zero value to the envier, is exactly equivalent to the two local inequalities x_i≤2x_(i−1)+1_(x_(i−2)=0) and 2x_(i−1)≤x_(i−2)+q+1_(x_i=q). They depend only on consecutive triples, so closed walks on state pairs (a,b) with binomial(q,c) weight count every labeled orientation exactly once, yielding trace(T_q^n). Integer Newton identities verify q2/q3 characteristic polynomials and their cubic recurrences; positive dominant roots with other eigenvalue moduli≤1 yield exponential survival bases. Independent direct all-good EFX orientation enumeration checks small n,q including zero-value goods and independent exact charpolys q2,3. Infinite n,q follows from the bijection, not finite tests.
